events_catalog.scenario_text: An unpredicted mid-morning blizzard hits the GTA. The TTC Line 1 is entirely suspended between Bloor-Yonge and Union.

choice_a.action_text: Order an immediate surge-priced rideshare down to the Financial District.

choice_b.action_text: Wait outside on the platform for an overcrowded surface shuttle bus.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You run into a local supermarket for exactly three basic grocery items, but grocery math hits you hard at the checkout counter.

choice_a.action_text: Suck it up, pay the ridiculous $52 balance, and lose your meal prep liquidity.

choice_b.action_text: Leave the basket at the aisle, walk out empty-handed, and eat instant noodles instead.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You tap your Presto card at the turnstile and hear a loud double-beep. Your balance is deeply in the negative.

choice_a.action_text: Execute an immediate phone top-up of $30 via your clearing account.

choice_b.action_text: Evade the gate smoothly. Risk getting caught by fare inspectors to save the cash.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The inter-campus shuttle bus is completely full, and the outdoor lineup stretching past the sidewalk is moving at zero speed.

choice_a.action_text: Pay for a local GO Transit train ticket to bypass the student freeze.

choice_b.action_text: Stand in the freezing wind for another 45 minutes to preserve your liquidity.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You walk through the Eaton Centre to kill time between classes and find a massive pop-up clearance sale on local brand apparel.

choice_a.action_text: Splurge $85 on a sleek hoodie to fit in with the local campus culture.

choice_b.action_text: Keep your eyes locked on the floor, walk straight past, and drink free tap water.

events_catalog.scenario_text: It is 11:30 PM. Your major midterm exam is in exactly 9 hours and you have only reviewed 2 out of 11 heavy slide decks.

choice_a.action_text: Consume your inventory Surge Espresso, pull an all-nighter, and force-memorize the slides.

choice_b.action_text: Get 8 hours of premium sleep, wing the exam completely, and accept whatever grade drops.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The campus Tim Hortons line has 40 people in it, and your lecture starts in 10 minutes. Your brain desperately demands caffeine.

choice_a.action_text: Skip the lecture completely to secure your breakfast wrap and double-double.

choice_b.action_text: Sprint to the lecture hall empty-handed. Endure a 3-hour academic briefing with zero focus.

events_catalog.scenario_text: As you exit Yonge-Dundas station, an aggressive street marketer approaches you trying to block your path with a clipboard entry form.

choice_a.action_text: Make awkward eye contact, listen to their pitch for 15 minutes, and miss your connection.

choice_b.action_text: Deploy your Mississauga Commuter passive edge, pretend you are blind, and walk straight through.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The campus Eduroam Wi-Fi network completely collapses right in the middle of your timed online quiz submission window.

choice_a.action_text: Instantly switch on your phone's premium 5G data hotspot to save the submission score.

choice_b.action_text: Stare at the loading icon in pure panic. Let the session timeout and email your prof later.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your economics professor locks 20% of your total class grade behind a digital homework portal access code that must be bought new.

choice_a.action_text: Pay the massive $125 portal access fee to secure your academic graduation tracking.

choice_b.action_text: Refuse to pay on principle. Try to clear the class using lecture slides alone.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your student house landlord slips an unauthorized notice under your door demanding an immediate illegal rent increase for winter heating.

choice_a.action_text: Pay the extra $150 cash out of pocket to completely avoid an aggressive winter eviction battle.

choice_b.action_text: File an immediate legal dispute board claim. Suffer intense household psychological warfare.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your evening Spadina streetcar gets completely gridlocked behind an illegally parked delivery van during a heavy freezing downpour.

choice_a.action_text: Abandon transit completely and walk 25 minutes through the heavy freezing rain.

choice_b.action_text: Sit in the gridlock for over an hour. Watch your evening study velocity hit zero.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Someone takes your wet clothes out of the student building dryer and throws them on top of the dirty counter to steal your cycle time.

choice_a.action_text: Pay for an entirely new washing cycle and wait around to guard the machine physically.

choice_b.action_text: Confront the room operator aggressively. Melt down your baseline sanity reserves in an argument.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your student cafeteria card registers $0.00 and your fridge contains nothing but a single, ancient jar of store-brand condiment.

choice_a.action_text: Redeem your inventory Meal Plan Voucher item to access the elite dining hall buffet.

choice_b.action_text: Borrow $25 from a friend at a steep psychological cost. Buy a cheap fast food meal.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The Bloor-Yonge subway platform is at emergency capacity. People are pushing against the yellow line as trains pass empty.

choice_a.action_text: Squeeze violently into an overcrowded car. Sacrifice your safety baseline for speed.

choice_b.action_text: Exit the underground network completely. Walk 40 minutes uphill to save your health.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A signal failure at Union freezes every GO train. The departure board is a wall of red, and the platform is filling up fast.

choice_a.action_text: Take an emergency Uber surge ride.

choice_b.action_text: Wait 90 minutes on the packed platform.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Rogers and Bell both go down an hour before a big deadline. The router blinks at you like it knows.

choice_a.action_text: Buy a café latte and work from a noisy coffee shop.

choice_b.action_text: Burn through mobile hotspot overage data.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You open the fridge for your meal-prep containers. They are empty, washed, and sitting on the rack like nothing happened.

choice_a.action_text: Order late-night shawarma takeout.

choice_b.action_text: Eat plain crackers and hold a silent grudge.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A January polar vortex hits and the condo heater picks tonight to quit. The windows are growing frost on the inside.

choice_a.action_text: Buy a space heater and heavy thermal socks.

choice_b.action_text: Wear 4 hoodies indoors and tough it out.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A notice slides under the door: an above-guideline rent increase. The letter is calm and polite, which makes it worse.

choice_a.action_text: Pay a paralegal consultation fee to fight it at the LTB.

choice_b.action_text: Stress-read Reddit tenant threads all night.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A surprise snowstorm buries the city overnight. The sidewalks are unplowed, and the grocery run you planned just got serious.

choice_a.action_text: Order grocery delivery with a winter tip.

choice_b.action_text: Trudge 2 km through slush in wet sneakers.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A street preacher with a megaphone stops the Dundas Square crowd dead. Everyone is shuffling, nobody is moving.

choice_a.action_text: Put on noise-cancelling headphones and detour through the PATH.

choice_b.action_text: Get trapped in the crowd and miss your connection.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A delivery van is double-parked right on the King streetcar tracks. Your streetcar stops. So does everything else.

choice_a.action_text: Hop off and power-walk 12 blocks in the rain.

choice_b.action_text: Sit motionless for 40 minutes.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your health card needs renewing, and the ServiceOntario line is already three hours long. The number on your ticket is 214.

choice_a.action_text: Take an unpaid half-day off to wait it out.

choice_b.action_text: Leave early and risk expired-coverage anxiety.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A friend texts a last-minute invite to watch the Raptors and Leafs game. The group chat is already celebrating.

choice_a.action_text: Go out for wings and drinks with friends.

choice_b.action_text: Stay home to save money and watch highlights alone.

events_catalog.scenario_text: It is Saturday at St. Lawrence Market. The stalls smell amazing and the peameal bacon sandwich line is looking at you.

choice_a.action_text: Stock up on fresh peameal bacon and produce.

choice_b.action_text: Stick to instant ramen for another week.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Crosstown construction closes your stop and the detour signs point three different ways. Nobody around you knows either.

choice_a.action_text: Pay for a Bikeshare pass and pedal around.

choice_b.action_text: Get lost transferring between 3 shuttle buses.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A routine dental cleaning turns up a surprise: your insurance does not cover all of it. The receptionist smiles at you gently.

choice_a.action_text: Pay the out-of-pocket co-pay now.

choice_b.action_text: Delay the appointment and endure the toothache.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Kensington Market is all vintage jackets and pour-over espresso. Your wallet knows exactly what is going to happen.

choice_a.action_text: Treat yourself to thrift finds and pour-over coffee.

choice_b.action_text: Window-shop only and walk away disciplined.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A friend lands at Pearson and wants a pickup. Arrivals is a traffic maze, and the security guard has seen you drive by already.

choice_a.action_text: Pay for express garage parking to meet them inside.

choice_b.action_text: Circle Terminal 1 arrivals 7 times while security yells.

events_catalog.scenario_text: No Frills has a flash sale on pantry staples. The shelves are emptying and the bags look heavy.

choice_a.action_text: Haul 4 heavy bags home on the subway.

choice_b.action_text: Skip the sale and buy overpriced convenience snacks.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The cherry blossoms are out in High Park on a warm Sunday. Everyone is outside, and your laptop is quietly glowing at home.

choice_a.action_text: Spend a sunny afternoon relaxing outdoors.

choice_b.action_text: Work overtime from your laptop instead.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The sun is setting over Lake Ontario and the Harbourfront breeze is perfect. Your couch has a strong opinion too.

choice_a.action_text: Go for an evening jog by Lake Ontario.

choice_b.action_text: Doomscroll Toronto housing prices on your couch.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A 10-person VIP booth at a King West club cancels 30 minutes before doors open, leaving you on the hook for the minimum spend unless you fill it fast.

choice_a.action_text: Hustle outside Rebel & King St in -15°C wind to fill the booth.

choice_b.action_text: Take the promoter penalty and go home to study for tomorrow's quiz.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You just got off the 304 King Blue Night bus at 4:15 AM smelling like club fog, and your mandatory participation seminar starts at 8:30 AM.

choice_a.action_text: Chug two espressos and power through class.

choice_b.action_text: Sleep through the alarm and pay a classmate for notes.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A rival promoter at the corner of Portland & King is offering free entry to your regulars right in front of the velvet rope.

choice_a.action_text: Comp two rounds of drinks out of pocket to lock in the crowd.

choice_b.action_text: Keep your cash and work the smaller late-night walk-in crowd.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The head bouncer whispers that your guestlist won't skip the line tonight unless you slide him $40 upfront.

choice_a.action_text: Pay the $40 cut to keep your VIPs happy (+$95 from the door, net +$55).

choice_b.action_text: Refuse and make your guests wait 45 minutes in the freezing line.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A touring DJ asks you to host a secret Chinatown warehouse after-party starting at 3:00 AM, with a cash payout at sunrise.

choice_a.action_text: Run the warehouse door until 6:00 AM.

choice_b.action_text: Decline and protect your health before midterms.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your winter boots are salt-stained and soaked, and the club manager warns you look "too campus, not King West" tonight.

choice_a.action_text: Buy emergency dress shoes at the Eaton Centre on your way.

choice_b.action_text: Bluff your way past management and stay behind the booth.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A wealthy tech founder invites you to a $300/plate Yorkville dinner tonight with a generous "study allowance" gift, the night before your 30% midterm.

choice_a.action_text: Go to dinner and cram from 1:00 AM to 6:00 AM.

choice_b.action_text: Politely reschedule and lock in at Robarts Library.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You scored two floor tickets to a sold-out Scotiabank Arena show for $240 and buyers are bidding $520, but the event starts in 40 minutes.

choice_a.action_text: Hold out for a $600 last-minute buyer outside Union Station.

choice_b.action_text: Sell immediately at $460 for a guaranteed profit.

events_catalog.scenario_text: After a lavish Harbourfront dinner, your date pushes for an unscheduled weekend trip to Montreal that would make you miss two labs.

choice_a.action_text: Set a firm boundary, take an Uber home, and keep your dignity.

choice_b.action_text: Agree to go, accept the generous trip allowance, and fake a doctor's note for your labs.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A surprise Toronto sneaker drop goes live at 10:00 AM during your tutorial, with resale pairs flipping for a $250 profit.

choice_a.action_text: Slip out of tutorial and sprint to Queen West.

choice_b.action_text: Stay in tutorial and flip online accessories instead.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You were gifted a luxury handbag worth $600, and your landlord just texted reminding you rent is due in 48 hours.

choice_a.action_text: Consign the bag quietly at a Yorkville boutique for fast cash.

choice_b.action_text: Keep the bag for social clout and scramble for rent money.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Someone posts a blurry photo of you stepping out of a Maybach on Bloor Street in your program's 400-student Discord.

choice_a.action_text: Own it with confidence and turn it into side-hustle promo.

choice_b.action_text: Stress out and lay low for the rest of the week.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A used laptop on Kijiji is priced way under what the same model resells for. The seller wants cash in an hour.

choice_a.action_text: Buy it and flip it.

choice_b.action_text: Scroll past and save your money.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A campus hackathon has a $40 entry fee and a $200 prize, and your friends are signing up as a team.

choice_a.action_text: Pay the entry fee and go all in.

choice_b.action_text: Skip it and sleep in.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A vintage leather jacket at a Kensington thrift shop looks like a resale gem. Or like a very expensive coat that smells like a basement.

choice_a.action_text: Buy it and list it online tonight.

choice_b.action_text: Just browse and enjoy the afternoon.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A friend offers you half of a food stall at the weekend night market. It will either sell out or sit in the cold.

choice_a.action_text: Split the stall and hope for a sellout.

choice_b.action_text: Pick up an extra shift instead.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A visiting student offers top dollar to sublet your room over reading week, if the listing and the landlord both cooperate.

choice_a.action_text: List the room and take the risk.

choice_b.action_text: Stay put and catch up on rest.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your group project is due at 9 AM. You can pull an all-nighter and bet on a top grade, or sleep and take what comes.

choice_a.action_text: Pull the all-nighter and go for the top mark.

choice_b.action_text: Go to bed. The project can be what it is.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You could busk at Dundas Station with a borrowed guitar. A good crowd pays well, and a bad one is humbling.

choice_a.action_text: Take the spot and play your heart out.

choice_b.action_text: Take a shift at a café instead.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A visiting investor says you have five minutes in a hallway. It could change your month, or your confidence.

choice_a.action_text: Pitch with everything you have.

choice_b.action_text: Politely decline and keep your focus.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A flash -25°C polar vortex warning lands on your phone. The wind chill is already cracking the windows.

choice_a.action_text: Rush-buy a heater and thermal layers.

choice_b.action_text: Ignore it and brave the cold.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your landlord emails an "urgent adjustment" to this month's fees, effective immediately.

choice_a.action_text: Pay the surprise fee and move on.

choice_b.action_text: Dispute it and lose sleep over it.

events_catalog.scenario_text: TTC Line 1 shuts down between stations on exam morning. The platform announcement is just static.

choice_a.action_text: Grab a surge rideshare to campus.

choice_b.action_text: Sprint through the slush on foot.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A client pays you early for a side job, unannounced. A pleasant surprise, and it won't last.

choice_a.action_text: Bank all of it.

choice_b.action_text: Split it with friends for a night out.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The whole building loses power with an assignment due in two hours. Your laptop is at 9%.

choice_a.action_text: Rush to a café with outlets.

choice_b.action_text: Finish it by phone flashlight.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A pipe bursts in the unit above and water is coming through your ceiling.

choice_a.action_text: Pay for emergency cleanup.

choice_b.action_text: Mop it up yourself all night.

events_catalog.scenario_text: A Presto glitch charges you twice for the same trip right before a shift.

choice_a.action_text: Sort it out at the customer service counter.

choice_b.action_text: Eat the loss and keep moving.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The fire alarm goes off at 3 AM. It is -12°C outside and nobody told you if it's real.

choice_a.action_text: Spend the rest of the night in a 24-hour diner.

choice_b.action_text: Shiver outside until the all-clear.
